scope: Upgrade compatibility for Tenant records admitted before tenant_repository_bindings existed. No Instance deployment, provider mutation or real-money mutation.

implementation.owner: Tenant-owner startup configures the installation registry facts and calls BackfillTenantRepositoryBindings before it registers request handlers.
implementation.identity: Each missing binding uses tenant-<sha256-prefix> from the durable Tenant ID. Backfill never calls Gateway and never replaces an existing binding.
implementation.concurrency: A transaction-scoped PostgreSQL advisory lock serializes a startup backfill; the existing per-destination advisory lock and unique index retain collision safety with admission.

focusedVerification.coverage: isolated PostgreSQL verifies admission collision handling, ID-derived historical backfill, repeated-startup idempotency, and preservation of a pre-existing destination.
a historical Tenant is backfilled before the real BuildKit owner chain pushes to 127.0.0.1:<port>/result/tenant-4ec4af08c009c4034dc47a88.
product boundary, 243 Node source tests, browser suite, lint/build and PostgreSQL owner-module checks.

notProven: A Tencent/TKE-hosted Cloud Build pushing a Tenant-resolved destination to the customer personal-TCR repository.
Physical repository materialization on personal TCR for a historical Tenant.
